clips.title: The story
paras: In north-central Ashenvale, Iris Lake lies east of Astranaar, its waters turned yellow-green by corruption from Felwood. Bog beasts prowl its shores.

Iris Lake lies between Astranaar and the moonwell tended by Shael'dryn, its waters fouled since the Third War. Fel energies drift south from the tainted heights of Felwood and poison the basin, turning clear water into a yellow-green mire. The corruption has twisted the native plants and water spirits, and aggressive bog beasts lash out at travelers who come near.

Pollution chokes Iris Lake, yet sacred remnants of the past linger along its edges. Rare crystalline stones called Elune's Tears sometimes rest on the muddy banks. Keepers of elven traditions, including Shael'dryn, seek the holy stones to help purify tainted moonwells and resist the demonic blight spreading across Ashenvale.
